body_markdown:
*Opening expands Huntington's South Carolina branch network to five full-service locations*


MOUNT PLEASANT, S.C.


, Aug. 31, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Huntington National Bank (Huntington) today announced the opening of its first branch in Mount Pleasant, continuing the expansion of its branch network across South Carolina.


The newly built, freestanding branch at 3149 N. Highway 17 brings Huntington to five full-service branches in South Carolina and builds on its presence in the state's Lowcountry. The Mount Pleasant location is part of Huntington's previously announced plans to open approximately 55 branches across North Carolina and South Carolina.


"Our Mount Pleasant branch gives us another opportunity to meet customers where they are as we continue to bring the full Huntington franchise to more customers and communities in the Carolinas," said Trent Holland, regional president for North Carolina and South Carolina. "This new branch reinforces our commitment to growing locally, supported by local bankers and relationships rooted in the community."


The Mount Pleasant branch offers a full range of services, along with local, personalized advice and guidance designed to assist customers with every step of their financial journey. The branch also features drive-thru teller lanes and a drive-up ATM, giving customers added convenience.


The opening of the Mount Pleasant branch deepens Huntington's presence in the South Carolina Lowcountry. Last month, Huntington opened its first branch in Summerville at 103 Station St., following last year's opening of its Charleston branch at 677 King St. The bank's South Carolina presence also includes full-service branches in Greenville and Spartanburg.


"We are honored to open this new branch in Mount Pleasant, extending Huntington's people-first, customer-centered approach across more of the Lowcountry," said Jennifer Schuchart, Charleston market president. "Our Mount Pleasant branch team looks forward to serving the community and building the strong relationships that are at the heart of how we do business."


With the addition of the Mount Pleasant branch, Huntington has expanded its branch network to 12 full-service locations serving a total of 10 markets across the Carolinas.


Learn more about Huntington Bank by visiting the new Mount Pleasant branch or[Huntington.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4762244-1&h=3266129427&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huntington.com&a=Huntington.com) .


**About Huntington** Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is a $284 billion asset regional bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. A top 10 U.S. commercial bank, The Huntington National Bank and its affiliates provide consumers, small and middle-market businesses, corporations, municipalities, and other organizations with a comprehensive suite of banking, payments, wealth management, and risk management products and services. Founded in 1866, Huntington operates over 1,400 branches in 21 states, with certain businesses operating nationally.
